contentText:
Uber may be breaking up with Waymo, but it's also gaining a new robotaxi BFF : Amazon. Starting today, Uber riders in Las Vegas can be matched with Amazon-owned Zoox's purpose-built, bidirectional robotaxis.

It's a first for both companies: the first time Uber is adding a purpose-built, steering-wheel-free autonomous vehicle to its network, and the first time that Zoox is opening up its fleet to a third-party app . Uber says that anyone ordering an UberX, Uber Comfort, Uber Electric, Uber Comfort Electric, or Wait & Save in Sin City can get matched with a Zoox at no extra charge.
